text:
sam: FYI I just opened PR 41299 to reorder fallback priority in the allocator. It fixes a pathological eviction case we saw on ded3. Link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/41299

maya: looking now. quick q — does this change affect the on-path KV cache TTL logic or just eviction ordering?

sam: just ordering. TTL/code paths unchanged. The bad case was: small jobs were getting preferentially kept because of stale priority slots. This flips priority to be size-aware. added unit + a short integration test.

leo: I'll take infra perf/security pass. can you add a short repro (steps) I can run locally? also any perf numbers from the integ?

sam: repro in PR description: reproduce with workload script under ./tools/evict/repro.sh (runs against local allocator emu). integ numbers in the PR comment — 12% tail latency improvement for eviction under adversarial load.

nina: tagging security: quick check for header ordering/metadata leakage please. change touches request routing for eviction decisions and we should ensure no auth metadata is used inadvertently.

buildkite-bot: CI passed — unit tests (linux) • integration (smoke) • lint OK

maya: small nit in allocator_test: prefer using TestClock::advance rather than sleep to keep CI deterministic. i'll push a tiny test change to your branch if you're ok.

sam: yes please, thanks. merge timing: i'd like to get this in before tomorrow's maintenance window. if leo + nina can give LGTM by EOD, i'll queue.

leo: sounds fine. i'll run repro now and aim to post review by ~1:00pm PT. if all good, one infra LGTM + one runtime LGTM should be sufficient (per recent merge policy).

nina: i'll do a quick scan for metadata auth usage and reply by 3pm PT. if anything major, will call it out.

maya: added the deterministic test tweak and a comment explaining the priority heuristic. pushed as a follow-up commit to sam/pr-41299.

sam: awesome. ping me if either of you want me to roll back the test tweak. otherwise i'll watch for LGTM and then schedule merge. :thumbsup:

leo: review up — left two minor comments around variable names, nothing blocking. posting LGTM once those are addressed.

nina: security quick scan done — no auth header reads, just metadata tags we already sanitize. LGTM from security side.

sam: addressing leo's naming comments now, will push in ~10m and then request merge. thanks all.

maya: :shipit:

buildkite-bot: Merge queue updated — awaiting final CI run before merge.
